app.title: LMS Pro Suite
app.tagline: Industrial learning operations for managers and learners.

auth.title: LMS API Access
auth.hint: This app talks to a real, authenticated API. Enter the access code to sign in.
auth.learnerHint: Sign in with your employee code to see your assigned courses.
auth.sessionExpiringSoon: Your session will expire in less than {{minutes}} minutes. Save any in-progress work, then sign in again.

theme.heading: Theme
theme.hint: Hover to preview. Click to apply.

courseCatalog.title: Course Catalog
courseCatalog.description: Search, review, and mark courses as mandatory.

assignForm.title: Assign Course
assignForm.description: Assign content to a learner or a whole team.
assignForm.teamHint: This will assign the course to {{count}} learners in the team.

progressTracker.title: Progress Tracker
progressTracker.description: Track progress and sync external learning activity.

mandatoryGaps.title: Mandatory Course Gaps
mandatoryGaps.description: Identify employees with pending mandatory courses.
mandatoryGaps.hint: Employees who have not completed all mandatory courses.
mandatoryGaps.allCompliant: All employees in this scope are compliant.

teamsDirectory.title: Teams Directory
teamsDirectory.description: Every team across the organization, independent of the scope filter above.

personas.title: Learner Personas (Preview)
personas.description: A preview of what a learner or team manager would see, built from data already loaded here - not a real sign-in and not a security boundary. A real Learner login (server-verified, scoped to just that learner's own data) is a separate option on the sign-in screen.

teamManager.noAssignments: No assignments for this team yet.
teamManager.gapsHint: Who has not completed mandatory courses in this team.

individual.loginHint: Enter an employee code to preview their learning data as a manager - this looks up data already loaded into this Manager session and never leaves the browser. It is not a login and proves nothing about identity; a real Learner sign-in is on the main sign-in screen.

learnerSelfService.loadError: Failed to load your profile or assigned courses.

skillMatch.title: Skill-Based Interview Priority
skillMatch.description: Rank employees for client interviews using completed-course skills.
skillMatch.emptyHint: Run analysis to generate a prioritized interview shortlist. Employees will still be ranked even with weak exact skill matches.
skillMatch.scaleHint: Score is out of 20 (4 categories, capped at 5 each: matched skills, matched courses, mandatory-course compliance, overall completion depth). Missing Skills shows exactly which requested skills this employee has not demonstrated.

errors.loadDashboard: Failed to load dashboard data. Ensure backend is running on http://localhost:5000.
errors.enterSkillKeyword: Enter at least one skill keyword (example: cloud, security, ai).
errors.fetchSkillMatch: Failed to fetch skill match report.
errors.syncUdemy: Failed to sync progress from Udemy.
errors.syncLinkedIn: Failed to sync progress from LinkedIn Learning.
errors.updateMandatory: Failed to update mandatory course flag.
errors.enterEmployeeCode: Enter your employee code to continue.
errors.loadTeamView: Failed to load team manager view.
